meta.lane: M2/T6021 RVBAR latch/reset lifecycle audit (independent, static-only)

flag_semantics.dev+0x41F (1055): fw-latched/pre-loaded mode flag. SOLE writers are in ANEHWDevice::start: set 1 at 0x9600ed4 iff provider->getProperty("pre-loaded") non-null (IORegistryEntry::getProperty vtable slot +0x2d8 salt 0x37a5, cstring 0x74c4968); cleared 0 at 0x9600fdc otherwise. NEVER written by ANE_Init/ANE_deInit/timeout paths. Consumers: ANE_Init gate (0x95e9850), ANE_LoadFirmware_gated (0x95f033c/0x95f046c: 1 -> ANE_ctrrReloadFw reload path, 0 -> fresh staging path), aneAddressToHostAddress, ANE_GetStatus_gated.
flag_semantics.dev+0x3FB (1019): fw-initialized flag gating ANE_deInit inside power_off.

rvbar_write_site.mechanics: gate dev+0x41F bit0 -> skip; read64OneShot(accessor dev+0x188 ENGINE reg[0], 0x1050000) bit0 set -> skip; else write64(dev+0x188, 0x1050000, 0x0081000000000001 | (FWIM_DVA & 0xff7efffffffff800)). FWIM_DVA = *(dev+0x978 Params +0x18) (pass3). Absolute: ENGINE aperture 0x84000000 + 0x1050000 = 0x85050000, width 64.
rvbar_write_site.no_clear_write_exists: No instruction anywhere in the KC writes RVBAR with bit0=0. The driver never force-clears the latch by MMIO.

cpu_control_order.after_rvbar_block_both_paths: write32(accessor dev+0x188, [dev+0x4A0]=0x01400044 H14g, w2=0) at 0x95e99a8 then write32(same, 0x10) at 0x95e99d0; salt 0x1344 write32 slot; order strictly 0 then 0x10 AFTER latch (or after skip).
cpu_control_order.ack: read32(dev+0x188, [dev+0x454]) polled; expected 0x08042006 (SCRATCH7 fw-ready ack, matches selene fn 0x71a4 writer 0x285840064).

power_lifecycle.on: setPowerStateGatedPriv +0x120/+0x6e8 -> power_on_hardware_gated 0x96076e4: selector dev+0x3EA0!=0 or dev+0x3FC bit0 skips MPM (H14g: selector 0 per pass4/04630ef -> plain PMGR 0x2e0 AUTO_ENABLE-clear branch); EnableMPMClocksAndPower(false); EnableANEClocksAndPower 0x96077f8; bl ANE_Init 0x9607968; ret==0xE00002DD tolerated; other nonzero -> power_off then retry.
power_lifecycle.off: setPowerStateGatedPriv +0x588 -> power_off_hardware_gated 0x9607f48: claim 0x061B0019; dev+0x3FB bit0 -> bl ANE_deInit 0x9608028 (ANE_deInit has NO other caller in the entire KC: no bl at 0x25e8370, no fixup, no materialization); quiesce 5 IPC endpoints (slot +0x178 salt 0x9a99); bl DisableANEClocksAndPower x2 (0x96082d0/0x9608320); WaitForLastClocksPowerAssertion.
power_lifecycle.disable_chain: DisableANEClocksAndPower 0x95d2d00 -> DisableCPUClocksAndPower 0x95d396c (bl 0x95d3060/0x95d3158/0x95d3470) -> write32(PMGR accessor dev+0x190 [reg[1] 0x8e080000], 0x2e0, 0x00000000) at 0x95d3d80-0x95d3d9c; enable side = write32(0x0000000f) with read-validate mask 0xff/expect 0xff (pass4 anchors G/I).
power_lifecycle.ane_deinit: 0x95ec370: clears state bytes dev+0x406/0x407/0x404-area, stopFirmware/suspendFirmware/shutdownFirmware, HandleFirmwareTimeout_gated, SCRATCH0/1 teardown; NEVER touches dev+0x41F and NEVER writes RVBAR.

stale_latch_recovery.lawful_branch: RVBAR bit0=1 (or dev+0x41F=1) with fw NOT alive: ANE_Init skips latch, polls [dev+0x454] for 0x08042006; failure leads to ANE_Init's internal retry: bl power_off_hardware_gated 0x95eb280 -> bl power_on_hardware_gated 0x95eb3ac -> ANE_Init re-entry. power_off runs ANE_deInit + PMGR ps 0x2e0 <- 0 (domain off = the only mechanism that resets the ASC CPU and can clear RVBAR bit0); after the cycle the re-entry read64OneShot observes bit0=0 and takes the full latch path.
stale_latch_recovery.already_latched_alive: dev+0x41F=1 route: subsequent ANE_LoadFirmware_gated uses ANE_ctrrReloadFw (memmove into CTRR windows dev+0x7C8/0x7D0, dev+0x970=1) - no RVBAR/CPU_CONTROL touch; ANE_Init itself still pulses CPU_CONTROL 0->0x10 on its (power_on-time) run.

linux_first_boot_order: 1. PMGR ps 0x2e0 (via pmgr-pwrctl power-controller@2e0) write32 0x0000000f; read-validate 0xff (pass4).
2. MPM clocks/power per kext gating (selector=0 on H14g).

3. ANE_Init: InitANEScratchRegisters zeroes scratch cells (via dev+0x438..0x454 offset fields); write32 SCRATCH6=1; pulse SCRATCH7 1->0 (stale ack cleared); 2 logged reads; attempt counter dev+0x230++.
4. RVBAR write64 0x285050000 (ASC view; APG 0x85050000) = 0x0081000000000001 | (FWIM_DVA & 0xff7efffffffff800), only after read64OneShot bit0==0; skipped entirely if dev+0x41F bit0 or read bit0 set.
5. CPU_CONTROL write32 0x00000000 then 0x00000010 (0x28540044 ASC view), both paths, after latch-or-skip.
6. Poll A: read32 SCRATCH7 (dev+0x454 field) == 0x08042006 READY beacon, <=1000 x sleep(1ms); timeout -> power_off/power_on retry (lawful latch clear).
7. On success: drain endpoint queues, dev+0x404=0x0101, commandWakeup; boot counters++; suballoc header fill (Params DVA at [0x00], count 64, 256B template).
8. dsb st; publish pool DVA: write32 SCRATCH0=low32, SCRATCH1=high32 (dev+0x438/0x43C fields). PUBLICATION IS AFTER THE READY POLL, not before RVBAR.
9. write32 SCRATCH7 = 0xF7FBDFF9 (wake word) - releases fw wait loop.
10. Poll B: read32 SCRATCH7 == 0x08042006 DONE ack, <=1000 x sleep(1ms); then read-back SCRATCH0/1 reassembled u64.

Never export a 'pre-loaded' analog: dev+0x41F must stay 0. Stale bit0=1: the kext never infers alive from bit0 - it clears SCRATCH7 by pulse, kicks CPU_CONTROL, and demands a fresh beacon; failure -> domain power cycle.
unresolved_edge: hardware proof that PMGR ps 0x2e0 <- 0 actually clears RVBAR bit0 (ASC reset semantics) is not statically derivable; the driver's retry design presupposes it, only in-driver evidence is behavioral. Verification constraint (Main, 2026-09-20): engine-aperture accesses while the ANE domain is gated were previously fatal on real hardware - do NOT read 0x85050000 while the domain is off. Lawful next operation: gated re-enable first (ps 0x2e0 <- 0x0000000f, read-validate 0xff), THEN read64 0x85050000 and check bit0==0; if cleared, the stale latch was domain-cleared and the normal ANE_Init latch path may proceed.
main_corrections: 2026-09-20 Main: no engine-aperture read while domain gated/off (previously fatal); any read-back requires gated re-enable before read. Supersedes this lane's initial 'read after domain off' suggestion.
2026-09-20 Main: no hardware permission granted; this lane and downstream lanes remain static-only.

pass5_ack_ordering.scope: Main task: distinguish initial fw-alive ack vs post-publication ack; total order; stale-ack handling; receipt order correction. Coordinated with M2mapperevidenceaudit (selene side, ae6ecc9).
pass5_ack_ordering.scratch_offset_fields: dev+0x438..dev+0x454 = ENGINE-relative scratch cell offsets idx0..idx7 (pass2 pinned 0x438/0x43C=SCRATCH0/1; write sites prove 0x450=SCRATCH6, 0x454=SCRATCH7). [dev+0x454] has 12 reader sites and NO direct store - family filled by config copy; InitANEScratchRegisters 0x960F2A8 consumes them to zero every cell (write32 value 0 each). SCRATCH7 cell = 0x1840064 engine-relative = 0x285840064 ASC view (matches selene accessor 0x285840048 + idx7*4).

two_phase_handshake.phase0_clear: pre-RVBAR, legacy path: InitANEScratchRegisters zeroes cells; write32(SCRATCH6,1) 0x95e9550; pulse write32(SCRATCH7,1) 0x95e9658 + write32(SCRATCH7,0) 0x95e96e8 -> stale 0x08042006 or stale wake word CLEARED; two further read32(SCRATCH7) are os_log-only, NO compare/branch (informational, 0x95e9798/0x95e97f4); attempt counter dev+0x230++ (0x95e9840-0x95e984c).
two_phase_handshake.phaseA_ready: after RVBAR-or-skip + CPU_CONTROL 0->0x10: first read32(SCRATCH7) 0x95e9a8c; loop A 0x95e9adc..0x95e9b8c: sleep(1ms) x <=1000 (cmp #0x3e8 0x95e9af4), re-read, cmp w0,0x08042006 (0x95e9ab0); success -> +0x764; timeout -> 0x95eb164 region -> power_off/power_on retry (0x95eb280/0x95eb3ac). This is the INITIAL FW-ALIVE ack: fw (selene fn 0x71A4 per mapper lane) writes 0x08042006 beacon BEFORE needing pool DVA, so poll-before-publish is correct.
two_phase_handshake.publication: success path: boot counters (SCRATCH0/1 reads +0xcac), dev+0x41F read +0x1318, suballoc header fill, then dsb st (0x95eaa90); write32(SCRATCH0=poolDVA low32) 0x95eaa98; write32(SCRATCH1=high32) 0x95eaad0.
two_phase_handshake.wake: write32(SCRATCH7, 0xF7FBDFF9) 0x95eab08-0x95eab30 (movz 0xdff9/movk 0xf7fb) - releases selene wait loop (mapper lane: fw polls idx7 for this wake word, sleep 1000us loop).
two_phase_handshake.phaseB_done: read32(SCRATCH7) 0x95eab38; cmp w0, 0x08042006 (w22 built 0x95eaa88/8c; cmp 0x95eab58); loop B <=1000 x sleep(1ms) (0x95eab94); timeout -> 0x25e7078 fail; success -> read-back SCRATCH0/1 u64 reassembly +0x18dc/+0x1904. This is the POST-PUBLICATION ack (DONE).
two_phase_handshake.stale_ack_answer: same magic 0x08042006 marks both READY (pre-payload) and DONE (post-payload). The kext never decides aliveness from bit0=1 or from a read: it CLEARS SCRATCH7 by the 1->0 pulse before boot, so loop A can only pass if the fw re-beacons; loop B only passes after wake+payload. A stale DONE from a dead fw is impossible to false-positive after the pulse.

pass5_ack_ordering.no_latch_write_flow: readRVBAR bit0=1 (or dev+0x41F=1): RVBAR write skipped (single tbnz); CPU_CONTROL 0->0x10 still pulses (restart at latched entry); poll A still demands fresh beacon because phase0 cleared SCRATCH7; no alive inference from bit0; failure -> power-cycle retry which clears the latch via domain off. dev+0x780 (1920) bit0 and dev+0x781 (1921) bit0 are additional skip flags: 0x781 set bypasses RVBAR+poll entirely to the success join (fast path); 0x780 set (branch B) skips legacy pre-RVBAR block.
pass5_ack_ordering.order_correction: this receipt's earlier linux_first_boot_order placed SCRATCH0/1 publication before RVBAR - WRONG vs kext: publication (step 8) is after READY poll (step 6), which is after RVBAR+CPU_CONTROL. Corrected above. RVBAR full ASC-view address 0x285050000 (Main correction); APG view 0x85050000.
pass5_ack_ordering.wake_word_not_in_host_elsewhere: 0xF7FBDFF9 occurs in ANE kext text exactly once (the wake write); absent from all KC data regions - the ONLY host->SCRATCH7 writes in the kext are: pulse 1, pulse 0, wake word. The kext never writes 0x08042006 anywhere.
